_doc: Pearlshell Grotto: a dungeon inside a giant seashell, from the owner's concept (docs/reference/shell-grotto-concept.jpg). Built as its own page first (dungeon.html, docs/SHELL-GROTTO.md); it joins the game later through a secret entrance in a giant shell on the beach. Rules: src/core/dungeon.js. Floors are drawn in order and the last one containing a point is the ground there: circle {c,r}, ellipse {c,rx,rz}, path {pts,w} (smoothed polyline), stairs {a,b,w,y0,y1} (a ramp from a to b). kind: stone/sand/nacre walk, shallow walks under waterY, deep is water nobody walks. Facing angle a points along (sin a, cos a).
